description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkModeRuntime component, focusing on speech recognition request configuration and playback plan fallback logic. It uses the Swift testing framework and references the Speech framework.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntimeSpeechTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for verifying speech recognition request configuration and playback plan fallback behavior.

methods.name: speech request uses dictation defaults
methods.description: Tests that the recognition request is configured to report partial results and sets the task hint to dictation.

methods.name: playback plan falls back only from elevenlabs
methods.description: Verifies the fallback logic of the playback plan, ensuring it defaults correctly based on provided API key and voice ID.
